assertions: Original attribute value/copy/overload and namespace history behavior is preserved.
Calc ATTR_USERDEF122 default/copy and unsigned16 pooled item contracts are source-grounded.

stackDivergence.rationale: Task144 implements original SvXMLAttr, SvXMLAttrCollection, SvXMLAttrContainerData and SvXMLAttrContainerItem value/default/copy/assignment/accessor contracts using existing shared SvXMLNamespaceMap and SfxPoolItem. Native vector/unique_ptr/OUString value storage is represented by JS arrays, immutable UTF16 strings and GC, without refcounts, destruction or move-lifetime emulation. Original overload acceptance, colon assertion boundaries, conflicting-prefix Add4 versus Set4 result, alias canonical-prefix changes, unpruned namespace history/order-sensitive attribute equality and item unsigned16 count/index narrowing are preserved. Actual Calc ATTR_USERDEF122 is a source-backed value witness, not a fabricated document pool. Presentation returns false without changing actual OUString; unused IntlWrapper is erased. Typed UNO QueryValue/PutValue and real SvUnoAttributeContainer/XNameContainer transport remain unported; inherited unsupported base operations are not advertised as native UNO parity. No cycle exception: actual editeng-to-xmloff dependency replaces the erroneous reverse removed in task143. Complete ScDocumentPool/ScPatternAttr/document/UI/ODS remain pending; existing deliberate I/O/recovery deviations retained.
